content: Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Sɑmuɛli u ɡu, mɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ mɛnnɑ bɑ win ɡɔɔ swĩ. Mɑ bɑ nùn sikuɑ win yɛnu sɔɔ Rɑmɑɔ. Yen biruwɑ Dɑfidi u seewɑ u dɑ u wɑ̃ɑ Pɑrɑnin ɡbɑburɔ.

Durɔ ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ Mɑoniɔ, win yĩsirɑ Nɑbɑli. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ Kɑlɛbun bweseru. U mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ dukiɑ bɑkɑɡii. U yɑ̃ɑnu mɔwɑ nɔrɔbun subɑ itɑ (3.000), bonu mɑɑ nɔrɔbu (1.000). Durɔ wi, u sɛ̃, win kookoosu kun wɑ̃, ɑdɑmɑ win kurɔ Abiɡɑli u bwisi mɔ. U mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ kurɔ burɔ. Kɑɑmɛliɔrɑ durɔ win ɡberu kpɑɑnɛ wɑ̃ɑ. Miyɑ u win yɑ̃ɑ nin sɑnsu bɔɔrimɔ.
N deemɑ sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Dɑfidi u mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ berɑ mi. Yerɑ u nuɑ mɑ Nɑbɑli u win yɑ̃ɑnun sɑnsu bɔɔrimɔ mi,
mɑ u ɑluwɑɑsi tɔnu wɔkuru ɡɔrɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i doo Nɑbɑlin mi, i mɑn nùn tɔbiriɑ.
I nɛɛ, Gusunɔ u win wɑ̃ɑru dɑkɑɑ dɑɑsiɑ, kpɑ u n wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ wi kɑ win yɛnuɡibu, kɑ ye u mɔ kpuro.
Wee, tɛ̃ nɑ nuɑ mɑ bɑ win yɑ̃ɑnun sɑnsu bɔɔrimɔ. Mɛyɑ sɑ mɑɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ win yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobu sɑnnu. Sɑ ǹ ben ɡoo torɑrire. Mɛyɑ ben ɡoo kun mɑɑ win yɑ̃ɑru biɑre sɑɑ mìn di sɑ wɑ̃ɑ Kɑɑmɛli mini kɑ be.

Ǹ n weesun nɑ, u win yɑ̃ɑ kpɑro be bikio. Yen sɔ̃, u de u bɛɛ nɛn sɔm kowobu mɛɛri kɑ nɔnu ɡeu. Domi i nɑwɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑrun sɑɑ sɔɔ. Yen sɔ̃nɑ nɑ nùn kɑnɑmɔ u nɛ win bii kɑ bɛɛ nɛn sɔm kowobu dĩɑnu kɛ̃ɛmɑ ni u mɔ.
Sɑɑ ye Dɑfidin sɔmɔ be, bɑ turɑ mi, yerɑ bɑ Nɑbɑli ɡɑri yi kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ. Yen biru bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡɑm ɡeruɑ.
Yerɑ Nɑbɑli u bu wisɑ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ rɑ n Dɑfidi, Isɑin bii. Tɛ̃ sɔɔ, yoo ɑluwɑɑsi dɑbirɑ tɑ rɑ kpikiru su sɑɑ ben yinnibun min di.
Yerɑ kon ben bweseru nɛn dĩɑnu kɑ nɛn nim kɑ yɑɑ wɛ̃ ye nɑ nɛn sɔm kowobu yiiye, be, be nɑ ǹ yɛ̃ mìn di bɑ wee?
Mɑ Dɑfidin ɑluwɑɑsi be, bɑ ɡɔsirɑmɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro ye Nɑbɑli u ɡeruɑ.

Yerɑ u win tɔmbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i de bɛɛn bɑɑwure u sɔɔru ko kpɑ u win tɑkobi suɑ u bɛki. Mɑ ben bɑɑwure u win tɑkobi suɑ u bɛki. Dɑfidi u mɑɑ wiɡiɑ suɑ u bɛki. Win tɔn be, bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɑtɑ. Yerɑ ben nɛɛru (400) bɑ nùn swĩi. Mɑ u derɑ ɡoobu (200) be bɑ tie, bɑ ben yɑ̃nu kɔ̃su.
Abiɡɑli u Dɑfidi somi
Yerɑ Nɑbɑlin sɔm kowo turo u nɑ u Abiɡɑli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee, Dɑfidi u bɛsɛn yinni sɔmɔbu ɡɔriɑmɑ sɑɑ ɡbɑburun di bu nùn tɔbiri. Adɑmɑ u bu ɡirɑ kɑ dɑm,
bɑɑ mɛ sibɑ sun ɡeɑ kuɑ. Ben ɡoo kun sun torɑri. Bɑ ǹ bɛsɛn yɑɑ sɑberu ɡɑru mwɛ sɑɑ ye sɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ be ɡbɑburɔ.
Wɔ̃kuru kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ, bɑ kuɑ bɛsɛn ɡbɑ̃rɑru, bɑ sun kɔ̃su sɑnɑm mɛ sɑ wɑ̃ɑ kɑ be, sɑ bɛsɛn yɑɑ sɑbenu kpɑrɑmɔ.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ koowo ye kɑɑ kpĩ ɑ ko. Domi Dɑfidi u bwisikɑ u bɛsɛn yinni kɑ win yɛnuɡibu kpuro kɑm koosiɑ. A mɑɑ yɛ̃ bɛsɛn yinni wi, u sɛ̃ sere ɡoo kun kpɛ̃ u nùn susi u nùn bwisi kɛ̃.

Ye Abiɡɑli u nuɑ mɛ, yerɑ u pɛ̃ɛ ɡoobu (200) suɑ fuuku kɑ tɑm bwɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑnu yiru kɑ yɑ̃ɑnu nɔɔbun yɑɑ kɑ dĩɑ bii sɔndɛn sɑkɑku nɔɔbu kɑ resɛm ɡbebi sɑɑki wunɔbu (100) kɑ dɑ̃ɑ mɑrum mɛ bɑ sokumɔ fiɡien ɡbebi sɑɑki ɡoobu (200),
mɑ u ye kpuro suɑ u kɛtɛkunu sɔbi. Mɑ u win sɔm kowobu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, i ɡbiiyo, nɑ wee biruɔ. Adɑmɑ u ǹ win durɔ ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɔ̃ɔwɑ.
Yerɑ u win kɛtɛku yɔɔwɑ u kpɑ kɑ ɡuurun yɛ̃sɑɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, Dɑfidi kɑ wiɡibu bɑ mɑɑ sɑrɑm wee mɑ bɑ yinnɑ kɛ.
N deemɑ Dɑfidi u rɑɑ nɛɛ, wee, kɑm sɔɔrɑ nɑ Nɑbɑlin dukiɑ kɔ̃su. Bɑɑ win yɑɑ sɑberun teerɑ kun ɡu ɡbɑburɔ. Wee tɛ̃, kɔ̃sɑ u mɑn dibu kɔsie.
Yen sɔ̃, nɑ̀ kun Nɑbɑli kɑ win ye u mɔ kpuro kpeerɑsie yɑm mu sere sɑ̃rɑ Gusunɔ u mɑn kuo mɛ u kĩ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ Abiɡɑli u Dɑfidi wɑ, yerɑ u sɑrɑ win kɛtɛkun di fuuku u yiirɑ u wiru tem ɡirɑri win wuswɑɑɔ.
U nɛɛ, nɛnɑ nɑ tɑɑrɛ mɔ, nɛn yinni. A de ɑ swɑɑ tem kpĩ ɑ nɔ ye kon nun sɔ̃.
Ye Nɑbɑli tɔnu kɑm wi, u nun kuɑ kpuro, ɑ ku ye ɡɑrisi ɡɑ̃ɑnu. Domi u sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe wiiro nɡe mɛ win yĩsirɑ ɡerumɔ. Mɛyɑ mɑɑ, tɔn be ɑ ɡɔrimɑ mi, nɛ kɑ be, sɑ ǹ wɑɑnɛ.
Sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru kɑ mɑɑ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ u nun yinɑri ɑ wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑn yɛm yɑri. Yen sɔ̃ tɛ̃, be bɑ nun tusɑ bɑ wunɛn kɔ̃sɑ kɑsu, u de bu kɑm ko nɡe Nɑbɑli.
Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, ɑ nɛn kɛ̃nu mɔɔ kpɑ ɑ nu wunɛn ɑluwɑɑsi be bɑ nun swĩi bɔnu kuɑ.

Nɑ nun kɑnɑmɔ, yinni, ɑ mɑn nɛn torɑnu suuru kuo. Domi Yinni Gusunɔ u koo de ɑ bɑndu di kpɑ tɑ n wɑ̃ɑ sere kɑ wunɛn bibun bweserɔ, yèn sɔ̃ ɑ tɑbu mɔ̀ win sɔ̃. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ torɑru ɡɑru wɑsi wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ.
Goo ù n nun nɑɑ ɡire u kɑsu u nun ɡo, Gusunɔ u koo wunɛn hunde bere kpɑ u nun kɔ̃su, ɑdɑmɑ u koo wunɛn yibɛrɛbɑn hunde kɑsɑ ko n tomɑ nɡe kpurɑntɛɛrun kperu.
Sɑɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔ u koo nun durom kuɑ mɛ u nun nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuɑ, kpɑ u nun ko Isirelibɑn kpɑro,
ɑ ku de wunɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡu nun tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ ɑ sere sɔnsɔnnu ko yibɛrɛbɑn yɛm mɛ ɑ yɑrin sɔ̃ ɑ kɑ wunɛn tii fɑɑbɑ ko. Yinni Gusunɔ ù n nun durom mɛ kuɑ, ɑ de ɑ mɑn yɑɑyɑ.
Yerɑ Dɑfidi u Abiɡɑli wisɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinni siɑrɑ wi u nun ɡɔrimɑ ɑ nɑ ɑ kɑ mɑn yinnɑ mini ɡisɔ.
Nɑ nùn siɑrɑ bwisi yi u nun kɑ̃n sɔ̃ yi ɑ kɑ mɑn yɔ̃rɑsiɑ n ku kɑ tɔnu ɡo n kɑ nɛn tii fɑɑbɑ ko.

Ye kpuro sɔɔ, Gusunɔ Isirelibɑn Yinniwɑ u mɑn yinɑri n kɔ̃sɑ ko. Adɑmɑ sere kɑ win wɑ̃ɑru, ɑ̀ kun dɑɑ nɛ nɛn mini fuuku, sere n kɑ ko bururu yɑm sɑ̃reru, bɑɑ Nɑbɑlin tɔmbun turo, nɑ ǹ derimɔ nɑ kun ɡo.
Yen biru u Abiɡɑlin kɛ̃ɛ ni mwɑ ni u kɑ nɑ sɑɑ win yɛnun di. Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡɔsiro kɑ bɔri yɛndu. Domi wunɛn tii ɑ wɑ nɡe mɛ nɑ nun swɑɑ dɑki. Nɑ mɑɑ nun dɑm koosiɑ kɑ kĩru.
Nɑbɑlin ɡɔɔ
Yen biru Abiɡɑli u ɡɔsirɑ Nɑbɑlin mi, mɑ u deemɑ wee, u tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑru dimɔ nɡe sinɑ boko, u nuku dobu mɔ̀, mɑ tɑm nùn ɡoomɔ. Adɑmɑ Abiɡɑli kun nùn ɡɑ̃ɑnu sɔ̃ɔwɑ ɡinɑ sere ye n kuɑ sisiru.
Sisi ten bururu Nɑbɑlin tɑm mu sɑrɑ mɑ Abiɡɑli u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ kpuro ye n koorɑ. Yerɑ u nɑndɑ sere win tororɑ kɑrɑ. Mɑ win wɑsi kpuro dwiiyɑ.
Sɔ̃ɔ wɔkurun biru Gusunɔ u derɑ Nɑbɑli wi, u ɡu.

Ye Dɑfidi u nuɑ Nɑbɑli u ɡu, yerɑ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ Yinni Gusunɔ siɑrɑ yèn sɔ̃ u mɑn sɑnnɑ, u Nɑbɑli kɔsie ye u mɑn kuɑ. Mɛyɑ u mɑɑ yinɑ nɛ win bɔ̃ɔ n kɔ̃sɑ ko. Win tiiwɑ u Nɑbɑli nùn win nuku kɔ̃suru kɔsie. Yen biru Dɑfidi u Abiɡɑli ɡɔriɑ u nɛɛ, u kĩ u nùn suɑ kurɔ.
Ye Dɑfidin sɔmɔ be, bɑ turɑ Abiɡɑlin mi, Kɑɑmɛliɔ, yerɑ bɑ nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ nɛɛ, Dɑfidiwɑ u sun ɡɔrimɑ wunɛn mi, su be nun suɑmɑ ɑ ko win kurɔ.
Mɑ kurɔ wi, u seewɑ u wuswɑɑ tem ɡirɑri mɑ u nɛɛ, wee, nɑ wurɑ n ko win yoo kpɑ nɑ n dɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbun nɑɑsu teye.
Yerɑ Abiɡɑli u yɑnde seewɑ u wɔndiɑbɑ suɑ tɔmbu nɔɔbu. Mɑ u win kɛtɛku yɔɔwɑ bɑ Dɑfidin sɔmɔ be swĩi, u dɑ u kuɑ Dɑfidin kurɔ.
Dɑfidi u rɑɑ mɑɑ Akinɔɑmu Yisirɛɛliɡii suɑ kurɔ. Mɑ be yiru ye, bɑ mɔre win mi.
N deemɑ Sɔɔlu u rɑɑ win bii Mikɑli wɔrɑ Dɑfidin min di u Pɑɑti, Lɑisin bii kɑ̃ u suɑ kurɔ. Pɑɑti wi, u sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gɑlimuɡii.
Dɑfidi u Sɔɔlu deri
u ǹ nùn ɡo
